name: colega-medico
description: Medical education and exam preparation for students and residents using fictional exercises.

interface.longDescription: Dr Kevin AI is a medical study companion for medical students and residents. It explains foundational concepts, helps review articles and guidelines, creates practice questions and fully fictional teaching cases, and demonstrates calculations in fictional exercises. It encourages learners to explain their reasoning and provides feedback with sources and stated uncertainty. It is intended for academic learning and exam preparation. It does not provide patient-specific diagnosis, prescriptions, treatment decisions, or operational clinical assistance, and does not request identifiable patient information.
defaultPrompt: Explain a medical concept and test my understanding.
Create a fictional teaching case and discuss the reasoning with me.
Help me analyze the methods and limitations of this article.

publication.release_notes: Refocused Dr Kevin AI on medical education for students and residents: practice questions, fictional teaching cases, literature review, and fictional calculation exercises. Removed patient-specific clinical assistance and corrected the category value.
